Before you read: three distinctions that matter

Acknowledged is not persisted

POST 200 confirms Kafka delivery. Database visibility, raw archival and Kafka source commit follow separately.

Report count is not disaster count

Several observations can describe one hazard. Sliding windows overlap; summing their counts double-counts reports.

Computed score is not real-world validity

The tiny text holdout and synthetic severity labels do not establish emergency-response usefulness.
